profilepage.name: Hussein Abdallah Bashuaib
profilepage.subtitle: Founder & CEO – BashSoft Digital
profilepage.bio1: I am a seasoned IT and operations leader with over 19 years of experience at DHL Yemen, where I progressed from IT roles to Deputy Country Manager. My career has spanned IT systems, logistics, quality management, and country-level operations, consistently delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, compliance, and stakeholder engagement.
profilepage.bio2: Since March 2026, I have been fully dedicated to building BashSoft Digital, my own technology business focused on application development, IT solutions, and digital transformation. At BashSoft Digital, I design and deliver modern web and mobile applications with professional UI/UX, multilingual support, and scalable architecture tailored to the needs of businesses in the Middle East and beyond.
profilepage.bio3: My expertise includes Microsoft 365 workflow optimization, Docker deployments, Django backend systems, React frontends, and MikroTik networking. I am passionate about combining technical accuracy with professional design to create solutions that empower organizations and individuals.
